content.short: 722 Capital manages onchain yield strategies for institutions, DAOs and family offices.
content.description: 722 Capital runs actively managed vaults that deploy across the more liquid yield protocols in DeFi, with a set of them curated on Hyperliquid. Net asset value is published on-chain, fees are encoded in the vault contract and depositors hold shares they can redeem on demand. The firm builds on Lagoon and Safe, which gives DAO and protocol treasuries multi-sig custody alongside real-time NAV reporting and audit-ready statements. Strategies include rotation across yield farms, each measured against a stated benchmark.
